commands: container exec <exact ID> python -B -c <fixed read-only proc status probe>
method.projection: Allowlisted Name, Pid, PPid and SIGTERM bits from SigCgt/SigIgn/SigBlk only; no arbitrary status text printed
method.docker_config: New empty temporary directory; removed automatically
method.side_effects: One temporary exec process plus Docker execution events; no persistent service or configuration changes requested
method.capture: Sanitized tool stdout transcribed into this artifact; not an independently repeated observation

limitations: Current signal dispositions are not historical signal-delivery or shutdown proof
Only the orchestrator was inspected, not other application process trees or storage contents
Mask observation does not inspect handler implementations or forwarding code
Selected metadata equality is not a full configuration or volume comparison
No credentials, service request, signal, stop, restart, preparation or cutover retry
